body-too-long: Body must be 20000 characters or less.
calendar-description: Scheduled publications grouped by their local date.
calendar-empty-description: Scheduled publications in this month will appear here.
danger-zone-description: Move this post to the bin. It stays recoverable.
drafts-coming-later-description: Your draft posts will appear here once the posts API ships.
drafts-description: Your unpublished posts. Search, open, and keep writing.
image-handoff-title: Your post was saved, but its image was not attached.
image-help: {{types}}, up to {{size}} each. Up to {{max}} images.
image-no-common-type: No image type is accepted by every selected destination. Deselect a destination or publish without images.
image-alt-nudge: Add alt text so everyone can follow your post.
image-limit-reached: You can attach up to {{max}} images. Extra files were left out.
limit-over: Too long for {{destination}} ({{actual}} / {{limit}} {{unit}}). Shorten the text to publish; you can still save a draft.
move-to-bin-confirm: Move this post to the bin? You can restore it later.
no-projects-yet: No projects yet — you can save without one.
publish-on-empty: No connected profile to publish to yet.
publication-review-mark-description: Only confirm if you can see this post on your profile. It will be recorded as published and will not be sent again.
publication-review-retry-description: We could not confirm whether this post is already on your profile. If it is, sending it again will post it twice, which is likely when the original attempt was over an hour ago on Mastodon. Check your profile first.
publication-category-message-fix-content: The provider refused this post's content. Edit the post, then retry.
publication-category-message-needs-revie: We could not confirm whether this post went out, so it was not sent again. Check your profile on the provider, then mark it as published or retry.
publication-category-message-reconnect: The account was disconnected or its credentials were refused.
publication-category-message-retry-later: The provider could not be reached or kept failing, even after automatic retries.
publication-category-message-unknown: The outcome could not be classified.
publication-retry-disabled-permission: You need publishing permissions to retry.
publication-retry-disabled-reconnect: Reconnect the account first, then retry.
publication-retry-disabled-superseded: Retry is only available on the newest publication of this post and account.
publication-retry-disabled-status: Only failed or paused publications can be retried.
publication-paused-next-action: Reconnect the account in Settings under Integrations to resume.
publication-paused-next-action-link: Reconnect account in Settings under Integrations
queue-description: Upcoming publications across your connected accounts.
queue-empty-description: Scheduled, in-progress, and paused publications will appear here.
unsaved-changes-description: You have unsaved changes — leave without saving?
segment-remove-description: The text of this segment will be lost.
segment-limit-reached: A thread can have up to {{max}} segments.
segment-over-limit: Segment {{index}} is too long to publish. Shorten it, or save a draft.
publish-blocked-media-required: {{destination}} needs at least one image. Attach one, or deselect it.
publish-blocked-threads-unsupported: {{destination}} cannot publish a thread. Remove the extra segments, or deselect it.
destination-panel-description: What you do not customize follows the shared post.
destination-media-none: The shared post has no images to customize.
destination-media-inherited_other: Inherits the {{count}} shared images, in the shared order.
destination-media-help: Choose which images this destination publishes, their order and their alt text.
destination-media-help-max: Choose which images this destination publishes (up to {{max}}), their order and their alt text.
destination-media-empty: No image will be published to this destination.
override-over-limit: {{destination}}: the customized text of segment {{index}} is too long. Shorten it, or reset the destination to the shared text.
override-blank: {{destination}}: the customized text of segment {{index}} is empty. Write it, or turn the customization off.
publish-now-too-many-destinations: You can publish to up to {{max}} destinations at once. Deselect some, or schedule instead.
schedule-past: Pick a date and time in the future.
scheduled-destinations-description: Customize what a destination publishes, until it is published.
rendition-saved-shared: This destination now follows the shared post.
rendition-save-post-first: Save your changes to the post first: a customization is checked against the saved post.
publication-superseded-description: A newer publication replaced this one for the same post and account.
rendition-draft-reloaded: The post's segments or images changed, so this customization was reloaded from the saved version.
